tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po'i chos grwa lho byang gnyis kyi nyer gcig dang nyer lnga'i dus ja so so'i thog dge rgyun btsugs pa'i yi ge bzhugs// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis dgongs dgos la/ rang re'i gdan sa chen po'i chos grwa lho byang gnyis thun mong dang tha dad du bris thang gras gcig mchod yul gyi dge rgyun du sbyar nas/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i chos spyod rnam dkar rgyun chags su gsar du btsugs pa'i legs byas 'ga' re sngar nas kyang spel ba bzhin/ da res kyang sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi shes rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas/ dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skyes te/ slar yang sprul pas sa skya pa'i bstan pa dkar 'jam du bya ba'i rgyur dmigs nas/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nyer gcig dang / nyer lnga'i dus ja gnyis la chos spyod cung yang ba 'dug pas/ de gnyis kyi nyer gcig gi skabs su chos spyod gzhan rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes su ltung bshags tshar gsum re dang / nyer lnga'i nyin bzang spyod tshar re dus rgyun ldan du ma chag pa mdzad dgos pa'i rten du/ sa bon khal drug 'gro ba'i rab zhing 'os bab spyi par sbyar ba'i zla ba lnga ba'i nyer gcig dus ja'i thog lo re bzhin nas 'bo re chag med du sgrub dgos dang / lhag par de rang la ngor pa mkhan chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas pas thugs dam chag pa kha gso dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yang chos tshul mang po zhig gsan pa'i chos yon dang / zhing brjes dus gshegs rdzongs sogs kyi skabs/ ngor thar pa rtse nas byung ba'i bris thang khyad par can gras gcig gi gtso bo lam zab brgyud pa la chos tshul tha dad pa'i brgyud pa yongs rdzogs re res bskor ba'i shin tu 'dus che ba'i zhal bkod ngo mtshar can 'di'i/

༈ /gtso thang dang po rdo rje 'chang la rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug dang khro bo bcu sogs gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ༈ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gshed dmar lha lnga'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /gsum pa sa skya pa chen po la kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo la kyai rdor mtsho skyes lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /lnga pa rje btsun rin po che la bde mchog chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /drug pa chos rje sa paṇa la dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bdun pa tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal la rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /brgyad pa gnyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /dgu pa brag phug pa bsod nams dpal ba la rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la kun rigs sa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu gcig pa dang po bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims la tshe dpag med pa'i bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu gcig pa gnyis pa grub chen bud+dha shrī la sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bla ma gtso bsdus kyis bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu gsum pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po la gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu bzhi pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bco lnga pa kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seṅge la sam+bu ṭa rdo dbyings kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/

༈ /bcu drug pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel la so thar sdom rgyun gyi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu bdun pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen la kyai rdor lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bco brgyad pa rje lha mchog seṅge la kyai rdor nag po zhabs lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /bcu dgu pa ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub la kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /nyi shu pa chos kyi rje sangs rgyas seṅge la bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba/ ༈ /nyer gcig pa chos rje shar sgang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan la sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba'i bris thang khyad par can 'di rnams/ rje lha mchog seṅge / rje sangs rgyas seṅge / rje nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams kyis rim par bzhengs shing thugs dam gyi rten du mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs pa/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi lag tu dad pa'i dbang gis bab pa 'di rnams chos grwa lho byang gnyis thun mong du tshogs pa'i cho 'phrul lo gsar gyi skabs dang / rje mus chen gyi dus chen chen mo'i skabs/ dbyar mthong sogs kyi dus bsod nams bsog pa'i zhing du dmigs te/ ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar du rtsa 'jags su phul ba yin pas/ nyer gcig gi ltung bshags dang / nyer lnga'i bzang spyod gnyis kyang zla ba ngo re bzhin dus ja byung res kyis chag med du sgrub pa'i do dam chos sde'i mkhan chen/ tshogs chen dbu byed/ spyi pa gnyis/ chos khrims las thog pa su yin sogs kyis dkon mchog thugs mi khrel ba'i do dam rus byed dgos yin pa/ 'dus pa'i tshogs kun gyis dgongs par bzhugs pa zhu/ 1 legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don 'grub/

/bstan pa cher rgyas nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ /smon lam 'pho ba'i dmigs pa la sogs pa/ 2 /gsal dang mi gsal ci 'drar gyur na yang / /rgyun du smon lam btab pa'i nus mthu yis/ /bar do med par mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing / /skad cig nyid la bsgrod de rang don kun/ 3 /mtha' ru phyin nas gang la gang 'dul gyi/ /sprul pas spyi dang bye brag bstan pa 'di/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du spel ba'i mthu ldan zhing / /'gro kun dga' ba'i zhing du 'dren par shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dge ba 'di rgyas par gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ chos grwa lho byang gnyis kyi nyer gcig dang nyer lnga'i dus ja so so'i thog dge rgyun btsugs pa'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
